user.title: Cramer Connect
user.description: Enter your Cramer Connect account credentials.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Cramer Connect
reauth_confirm.description: The password for {username} is no longer accepted. Enter the current password.

error.invalid_auth: Invalid credentials. Please check your email and password.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to Cramer servers. Please try again.

init.title: Cramer Connect options
init.description: Mowers with a security level that requires a PIN code only accept a start command together with the PIN.

error.invalid_pin: The PIN code must be 1 to 5 digits (0-65535).

park.name: Park
park.description: Send the mower to the charging station and park it.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Minutes to park. Leave empty to park until further notice.

set_schedule.name: Set schedule
set_schedule.description: Set the mowing timers for one or more weekdays. Days you don't select keep their timers. Leave a timer's times empty to turn it off. An end time of 00:00 means midnight.

days.name: Days
days.description: Weekdays to apply the timers to.

timer_1_start.name: Timer 1 start
timer_1_start.description: Start of the first mowing window.

timer_1_end.name: Timer 1 end
timer_1_end.description: End of the first mowing window.

timer_2_start.name: Timer 2 start
timer_2_start.description: Start of the second mowing window.

timer_2_end.name: Timer 2 end
timer_2_end.description: End of the second mowing window.

start_nonstop_mowing.name: Start nonstop mowing
start_nonstop_mowing.description: Mow continuously and ignore the schedule for a number of days.

days.name: Days
days.description: How many days to mow nonstop (1-24).

cancel_nonstop_mowing.name: Cancel nonstop mowing
cancel_nonstop_mowing.description: Stop nonstop mowing and follow the schedule again.

set_clock.name: Set clock
set_clock.description: Set the mower's clock to Home Assistant's time and time zone. The schedule depends on a correct clock.

park_rest_of_day.name: Park for the rest of the day
